commit_limitation: This protocol and all implementation pins must be committed before native launch; the exact pre-run commit is recorded in the execution handoff.
purpose: Test one diagnosed writer-representation repair: explicit observed-fact key/value binding with writer-only D1 training, while readers, gates, routing and the sealed backbone remain fixed.
hypothesis: The rejected reader-only arm left delayed associations unusable. Separating observed entity+attribute keys from value-only values may make associations query-readable without changing the state engine or reader. A negative result rejects this representation and preserves the parent.
parent_role: M3 shared ownership reference with failed retention, not an accepted general-memory baseline. M3 repair, M4 and rejected v1 candidates are not parents or defaults.

prerequisite_evidence.scope: Exact-reference and software integrity prerequisites are passing; prior learned reader-only quality remains rejected. Binding diagnostic is tiny CPU mechanism evidence only, not native quality evidence.

dataset.scope: Fresh disjoint counterfactual families with both variants, four query forms, independent distractors, absent facts, heldout-only observed values, and 16 unique evaluation retention questions across arithmetic, factual, abbreviation and relational prompts.

exact_reference.record_granularity: One immutable fact line per record; correction supersedes only the changed fact.
exact_reference.state_ownership: RecordLedger is authoritative; fast state is derived from observations and source-view-bound images.
exact_reference.recovery: Atomic image publication, transaction-fault rollback, stale-view rejection and permitted-source rebuild; not a power-loss or neural-unlearning claim.

evidence_gate.rule: Eligible structured fact must cover query content and an entity-like term. Conflict, absent evidence and unstructured lookalike text disable fast memory.
evidence_gate.disabled_behavior: Exact frozen-base inference with enabled_ports=() and no record/fast injection.

evaluation.adversarial_observation: The launch code for project Alder is teal.
evaluation.metadata_invariance: Changing split, role, kind or expected-answer metadata must not change route or generated tokens.
evaluation.chronology: Each evaluation episode writes six observed structured facts/distractors once, answers five initial queries, saves/reloads without source reencoding, appends one correction, then answers changed/unaffected/unknown/general queries.
evaluation.correction_scope: Latest-value append diagnostic; not deletion, revocation or neural unlearning.
evaluation.controls: Parent and candidate use the same fact-binding representation; disabled is exact frozen-base inference; shuffled is the same-family counterfactual state; last-chunk uses only the final page facts or correction; full-context supplies all observed facts; selective_context supplies authenticated exact records; adversarial is declared unstructured raw text.
evaluation.restart: One guarded fresh process reloads the exact candidate and first heldout corrected image, reproduces all seven corrected-stage answers and verifies source binding and seven-entry lineage.

training.optimizer_semantics: Int8 Muon momentum with FP32 parameters/gradients; auxiliary FP32 AdamW for nonmatrix parameters. No BF16-residency or FP8-training claim.
training.schedule: Seeded shuffle of round-robin query positions across all 16 fresh training worlds, one visit to each of 192 cases. Evaluation labels never train or select settings.
training.objective: Response-only teacher-forced CE on gate-on cases through the fact-binding writer. No general preservation KL is used: unknown/general cases are gate-off and have no differentiable fast path. Fixed evidence gating, disabled-token parity and diverse general retention checks preserve unrelated answers.

acceptance.failed_gate: Reject candidate and preserve parent; do not promote or advance neural RSI.
acceptance.route_accounting: Require 192 scheduled cases, 128 actual fast-route backward calls and 64 gate-off cases; update-level gradients only, no per-example gradient attribution.

stop_conditions: backward-only probe finds no declared trainable gradient
publication: None. One isolated writer-only candidate and one guarded restart; parent, selected defaults, source seals and rejected candidates are unchanged. Passing only qualifies this small diagnostic, not deployment or RSI.
implementation_overlay: New v5 arm only: fact-level key/value writer representation, writer-only D1 scope, explicit route/backward accounting, non-regression reference acceptance, and fresh diverse retention data. Historical protocols and verdicts are unchanged.

state_lineage.meaning: Six observed structured facts/distractors, then one correction; exact ledger admission remains seven records per episode.
